summary: Deep Fire to Combustion, plus Arcane Concentration and Missile Barrage from Arcane.
rotation: Combustion and the on-use trinket once Fire Vulnerability has 5 stacks
Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial) on a free GCD; mana gems never
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 90s left
Scorch to 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks and before they run out
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks (1.5s cast)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Fire Blast on cooldown at 10% mana or more (every Fire Blast adds a Heating Up stack)
Fire Blast, then Scorch, when a Fireball would not land before the end (its cast plus 1.04s)
Shoot the wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ignite rolls with no cap (SoD style, open). Its ticks never crit.
Heating Up: every Fire Blast adds a stack (two on a crit). One Pyroblast uses them all.
Fire Power counts Fire Vulnerability and up to 4 Fire DoTs. Open: whether it adds or multiplies.
Pyroblast DoT coefficient taken per tick
Open: Missile Barrage roll timing and its cost interaction with Arcane Power.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII). With the books: Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_fire unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Flame) as a mage option, as the preset does.
